## Information
Create a warm and enchanting ambiance in your home this Christmas with our 1000 LED 25m Indoor Outdoor Multi Function String Lights in Red & Vintage Gold! These mains operated TreeBrights are specifically designed to add a touch of magic to your Christmas tree, with LEDs spaced approximately 2.5cm apart on a green wire, offering three times more bulbs per meter than regular lights. Easy to install, these lights come with a 5m lead length from the UK 3 pin transformer to the first bulb, providing flexibility in placement. With 8 delightful functions to choose from, simply use the dual-purpose button on the transformer to switch between static, combination, in waves, sequential, slow glow, chasing/flash, slow fade, and twinkle/flash modes. Embrace the convenience of the built-in memory chip, allowing the lights to remember your previous setting for a hassle-free experience. Activate and deactivate the 8-hour on/16-hour off timer function by holding the button, adding an energy-saving touch to your festivities. Crafted for indoor and outdoor use, our IP20 rated transformer ensures safety as long as it's kept dry. With eco-friendly non-replaceable bulbs, you can save up to 90% on energy costs compared to traditional bulbs. Versatile and captivating, these lights are not limited to Christmas alone: use them throughout the year to create eye-catching scenes and provide ambient lighting.
